name: Himawari
source:
Energetic! Innocent! Popular!
A playtime expert who makes people smile and forgive everything she does!

A Shiba Inu owned by the protagonist. A friendly dog who really loves to play and isn't the least bit shy. Whenever she talks to someone who is feeling low, her smile turns their frown upside down.
She sometimes gets over-excited and causes issues, but everyone smiles and lets it go (more or less).
She loves touching the protagonist, and even though she gets yelled at for leaving paw marks on his clothes, that still doesn't stop her.

"I didn't mess up. I dropped it on purpose, silly. But it's all good, because everyone's smiling now, right? Tehe-pero."
